finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful advantage over every rival is excluded under both interval methods. All primary model-rival intervals include zero; primary performance is worse than uniform only under writer resampling. Adapted-minus-base donor useful advantage is excluded under writer resampling but remains unresolved under crossed resampling, while pooled useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods. Both residual model-rival intervals include zero under both methods. Residual forecasts are worse than uniform under both methods. Raw base, pooled and donor useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods, with all model-rival intervals including zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Additional passes repeat existing text; they do not add personal information. Sparse histories, calibration-selected rank, shared human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the recipe. No independent human confirmation, epoch ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
